title: Grateful Dead Live at RFK Stadium on 1973-06-09
lineage: MR cassette > Nakamichi 550 > Lexicon Alpha > Samplitude > CD-Tag > Flac-16

ai_review.summary: Audience recording captures a high‑energy 1973 show with an epic 49‑minute He's Gone > Truckin' > Playing in the Band sequence, though the tape shows some fuzz and limited fidelity.
ai_review.review: The concert is remembered as a scorching, crowd‑filled night at RFK Stadium, highlighted by a marathon He's Gone → Truckin' → Playing in the Band stretch that many reviewers call epic. The tape is an audience recording made on a Sony TC deck; it delivers the excitement of the night but exhibits typical tape‑age fuzz and occasional loss of clarity.

ai_rating.rationale: Strong show performance with standout jam sequence earns high show score; recording is decent audience tape with some fuzz, leading to a solid overall rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Audience tape recorded on Sony TC deck; generally clear enough to enjoy the performance but shows tape‑age fuzz and occasional muddiness, no wall‑of‑sound PA.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Long, flowing jam sequence (He’s Gone > Truckin' > Playing) dominates the second half; overall pacing kept high energy throughout the massive stadium crowd.
